title: Complete PORT_FORWARD method coverage
description: Verify and, where needed, fix automatic and manual port-forward configuration, listener ownership, remote forwarding, lifecycle, and failure reporting.
acceptanceCriteria: Automatic and manual port-forward inputs validate ports, protocols, endpoints, and node roles
Start/stop/restart/reconnect and listener cleanup are tested for TCP and UDP where supported
Port conflicts, invalid remote targets, and missing forwarder runtime produce specific errors
The UI/API reports the actual forwarding state and selected port, not only the desired configuration

steps.details: Extend existing port-forward tests with invalid protocols, port boundaries, conflict, cleanup, and state reporting cases.
Read forwarder, forwarder-runner, supervisor, schemas, and API/UI flows; identify concrete gaps only.
Correct listener/forwarder state or validation behavior proven by failing tests while preserving existing API shapes.
Run focused tests, custom harness, typecheck, lint, and browser fixture when available.

technicalNotes: The forwarder runner is Node-builtins-only and must remain compatible with `node --experimental-strip-types` on supported Node 22.
